var evens = numbers
    .Where(n => n % 2 == 0)
    .OrderByDescending(n => n)
    .ToList();

var names = people
    .Where(p => p.Age >= 18)
    .Select(p => p.Name)
    .OrderBy(n => n)
    .ToList();

var recent = await db.Orders
    .Where(o => o.CreatedAt > DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-7))
    .Include(o => o.Customer)
    .OrderByDescending(o => o.CreatedAt)
    .Take(10)
    .ToListAsync();
